title: Halloween Gear
needs_owner_check: The Widow chestplate, leggings and boots names (Widow's Carapace, Widow's Legwraps, Widow's Creepers) are marked as placeholders in AdvancedEnchantments armorSets/HalloweenWidow.yml at 63529705. Confirm them before this page ships.
summary: **Halloween Gear** is the retired Halloween 2026 line: the Widow armour set and a row of themed weapons and tools. It can no longer be obtained.

blocks.p: Halloween gear can no longer be obtained. It came from the Halloween Crate, which is retired. Gear that players already own still works, and it keeps its enchants and abilities.

ul: {{icon:widow_chestplate}} The Widow set: the Witch Hat, Widow's Carapace, Widow's Legwraps and Widow's Creepers.
{{icon:netherite_sword}} Weapons such as The Count's Fang, Trick or Stab and The Last Harvest.
{{icon:netherite_pickaxe}} Tools such as Grave Robber, Grave Digger and Grim Harvester.

blocks.p: Reaper's Toll is a one of one: exactly one exists, and its lore says so. Its Sharpness and Unbreaking are far above anything else on the server.

ul: Halloween gear says **It seems bound to you** in its lore and stays with you when you die. See [Keep-on-Death Gear](/wiki/smp/keep-on-death/).
It shatters instead of breaking, like Chromatic gear. Repair it with `/craft repair`.
